title: Package Migration Guide
description: Schema for a single package's migration guide entries

package.description: npm package name (e.g. rspack, webpack, eslint)

ecosystem.description: Primary ecosystem this package belongs to

migrations.description: Ordered list of migration guides, oldest-first

from.description: Source version or range (semver range, 'x.y', or a package name for cross-package migrations)

to.description: Target version or range (semver range or 'x.y')

title.description: Human-readable title for the migration guide

url.description: URL to the official migration guide

notes.description: Optional short note about the scope or difficulty of the migration

breaking.description: Whether this migration contains breaking changes (defaults to true for major bumps)
